svg.aria-label: Primary raw materials (crudes) from coal tar / petroleum
svg.title: Primary raw materials (crudes) from coal tar / petroleum
svg.desc: Structures of benzene, toluene, xylene, naphthalene, anthracene, phenol, cresol, pyridine and carbazole
svg.text: Primary raw materials (crudes) from coal tar / petroleum
Obtained by fractional distillation of coal tar (and increasingly from petroleum reforming)
